summary: Frontend-only test of the new global hamburger SiteMenu (MikiLab). Verified: site-menu-open present in header on all tabs (Home/Ricette/Impara/Community/Lab); drawer opens via portal; all 6 sections + all 6 tool categories present; 44 tool buttons (>20 required); close button and backdrop click both close the drawer; section navigation works (Ricette title 'Le Ricette di MikiLab' in IT, 'The MikiLab Recipes' in EN); Sfide section opens sfide-overlay; tool navigation from a NON-maestro tab works (custodite -> custodite-list, timer -> Smart Timer Multi-Impasto) after admin login. No JS errors, no white screens. ONE REAL BUG: choosing a tool from the menu while ALREADY on the 'Il Tuo Laboratorio' tab does nothing (stale localStorage key then hijacks a later Lab visit).

integration_issues.flow: SiteMenu -> tool while already on 'Il Tuo Laboratorio' tab
integration_issues.issue: Clicking any site-menu-tool-* when the current tab is already 'maestro' does NOT open/switch the tool (drawer closes, screen unchanged). Reproduced: opened tool timer from Home (OK), then chose site-menu-tool-custodite from the menu -> still Smart Timer; localStorage 'mikilab_pending_tool' remained 'custodite'. Root cause: Maestro.jsx reads localStorage 'mikilab_pending_tool' only in a mount-time useEffect ([] deps); navigate('maestro') while tab==='maestro' does not remount Maestro, so the pending id is never consumed. SECOND EFFECT: the stale key then hijacks the next Lab visit - clicking site-menu-section-maestro afterwards opened the stale tool (custodite) instead of the tool list.

action_items: Make tool selection work in-place: in SiteMenu.goTool also dispatch window event (e.g. 'mikilab-open-tool' with the id) and in Maestro.jsx add a window listener that calls setTool(id) + consumes/removes localStorage 'mikilab_pending_tool'. Alternatively remount Maestro with a key when a pending tool is set.
Always clear 'mikilab_pending_tool' after use (and defensively on Maestro unmount) to prevent the stale-tool hijack of a later 'Il Tuo Laboratorio' navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Maestro.jsx pending-tool useEffect has empty deps -> not reactive to repeat navigations from the global menu; use a custom window event instead of localStorage-only handoff.
localStorage handoff has no TTL/cleanup: a value written but never consumed permanently changes the Lab landing behaviour.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Global SiteMenu verified end-to-end except the same-tab tool switch. Note: default UI language in a fresh browser session was EN, so assert section titles per selected lang (use lang-select). IntroGuide did not block interaction in headless runs. Tool count = 44.
rca_of_the_issue: SiteMenu writes the tool id to localStorage then calls onNavigate('maestro'). If the active tab is already 'maestro', React does not remount Maestro, and Maestro only reads the key in a mount-time effect, so the tool never opens and the key stays behind, later hijacking the Lab landing screen.
